notes.fountain_encoding: 0x02 = fountain (subtype determined by game engine). 0x05 = mark (collectible item, NOT a fountain).
notes.sign_encoding: Each level has one sign message (clue index N-1 for level N). 0x30 = combined ladder_up + sign (0x10 | 0x20). The extra 0x30 cells in lower-right corners of L2-L6 form a decreasing count pattern (6,5,4,3,2,1) representing additional ladder_up+sign access points.
notes.level7_note: Wind maze: 175 of 256 cells are wind (0x03). Central hub room has ring of ladder_down (0x08) surrounding fountain cluster.
notes.marks: Mark of Fire and Mark of Kings are on L8. Not encoded as distinct ULT bytes (same as Dungeon of Snake).
